results.name: Media config exposes all 13 defined scenes, actual model capabilities and exact upload limits
Image upload decodes and re-encodes a real PNG to an owner-bound private WebP
Invalid magic, corrupt images and files over byte limits are rejected
Audio upload inspects decoded duration and normalizes real MP3 to mono 24 kHz WAV
Cross-user read and delete requests do not expose or remove private media
Concurrent uploads respect the per-user storage quota under a database lock
Reserved media credits refund exactly once across concurrent repeated failures
VAD ignores brief noise, detects a voiced segment followed by 700 ms of silence and bounds long speech
Interrupting before a valid reply cancels upstream work and refunds a reserved credit
A synthesis failure after valid text preserves the conversation and does not refund a completed turn
WebSocket upgrade requires an active session and an explicit allowed origin
Deleting an owned attachment removes its private file and makes historical links return missing

scope: Backend functions and ephemeral loopback WebSocket server; Next public routes and browser UI require separate deployment acceptance
cleanup: Temporary users, assets, conversations, notes, usage and billing rows removed; production service not started
